spec_case: issue #674: the scripted adapter's chunks makes progress deterministic
description: A reply's `chunks` delivers each piece as one delta before the reply completes; the final state (value, tokens, finish_reason) is byte-identical to the same reply without `chunks` -- `tests/adapters/test_scripted_chunks.py::test_chunks_reply_final_state_matches_the_same_reply_without_chunks` asserts that equality directly.
